name: Douglas Drummond
reason: Too thin: beyond his Esalen programmes (which count once) there are only two one-off November 2026 workshops (Embodied Leaders at UC Berkeley, 14–15 Nov; Healing Waters: Rites of Purpose in Culver City, 20–22 Nov), no books, no free resources and no teaching videos (his YouTube channel @drwdrummond holds five short 5Rhythms dance pieces from 2012); his website weavingwaters.com is mainly a hospitality and wellness consultancy, so the page would be empty of items within three weeks.
